claim_summaries: On the written closed-3-manifold interface allowing disconnected manifolds, a Sol mapping torus disjoint union a large flat 3-torus refutes replacing normalized-volume entropy by topological entropy in the factor-4 work bound.

A sufficient positive-volume computation bridge requires an invariant code set with certified volume fraction beta and conditional KS entropy rate kappa; then entropy affinity gives H >= beta*kappa and the work theorem yields W >= 4*nu*V*(beta*kappa)^2.
Time scaling, metric/measure choice, and force-per-mass conventions preclude a speed-independent per-instruction cost claim without additional acquisition and clock interfaces.
